suitableFor: full-width image-only hero galleries at the top of a detail page
rotating photo galleries with no overlaid heading/description/CTA
notSuitableFor: promotional carousels with heading + description + CTA per slide (use carousel-hero)

usage.notes: Distinct from carousel-hero: image-only slides (no text/CTA), used as a photo gallery hero on adventure detail pages. carousel-hero is scoped to promotional sliders with image + heading + description + CTA per slide.
